PLAN "Upper Body Strength for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper body strength for climbing, pain-free range, no overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Stability & Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
